purpose: Normalize family-level support width, foot heading, and COM targets while preserving state-specific uncertainty.

evidenceBoundary.sourceBackedTrend: Theropod and tyrannosaurid trackway evidence supports a generally narrow, digitigrade gait and a speed-conditioned reduction in step width.
evidenceBoundary.notSourceBacked: The numeric envelopes below, COM targets, and attack/brace/turn rules are engineering or gameplay priors, not fossil measurements.

hipHeightH.definition: Median pelvis or hip joint height above the evaluated ground plane over valid samples.
hipHeightH.fallback: Use a declared morphology-specific hip landmark; never infer H from species name.

localGroundFrame.travelTangentT: normalized measured root or COM ground velocity over the accepted local interval
localGroundFrame.lateralL: normalized cross(up, travelTangentT), with sign stabilized by actor side
localGroundFrame.axisRule: Derive T from measured motion; do not use a conflicting static forwardAxis field without reconciliation.

contactCentroids.left: Weighted centroid of deterministic sole and toe vertices classified as in contact.
contactCentroids.right: Weighted centroid of deterministic sole and toe vertices classified as in contact.
contactCentroids.forbiddenProxy: Ankle, foot-bone, or toe-root origin alone
maskRequirements: record vertex IDs and weight threshold
separate toe-dominant masks from broad ankle/shin spill-through masks

stanceSupportWidthNormalized.meaning: Simultaneous lateral separation of active support contacts.

stepWidthNormalized.meaning: Mediolateral distance between successive contralateral footfalls; do not conflate with stanceSupportWidthNormalized.

footHeadingPsi.formula: signed atan2(dot(cross(footAxis, T), up), dot(footAxis, T))
footHeadingPsi.footAxis: Projected direction from foot root or metatarsal base toward the toe-contact centroid.

comSupportMarginNormalized.formula: signed horizontal distance from COM projection to the active support-polygon boundary / H
comSupportMarginNormalized.staticRule: COM projection must remain inside the active polygon with the declared positive margin.
comSupportMarginNormalized.dynamicRule: Also evaluate capturePoint = COM + velocity / sqrt(g/H); use capture-point margin for moving or impulsive states.
comSupportMarginNormalized.comSource: Explicit mass-weighted COM or declared proxy with provenance; do not infer COM from a trackway description.

familyCalibration.aggregation: Calibrate within family and gait state; retain individual actor residuals rather than replacing them with a species constant.
familyCalibration.acceptanceRule: A target band is soft until the family profile has independent data and a declared uncertainty interval.

classificationSignals: no deliberate attack or brace impulse
straight_walk.crossover: forbidden unless an explicit high-speed or pivot state is declared

classificationSignals: lower measured speed than straight-walk family median
longer or more frequent double-support interval

brace.contactRequirement: both support contacts retained through the declared brace interval

attack.crossover: allowed only when explicitly authored and captured by the support polygon
attack.scientificBoundary: Do not present this state or its bands as a trackway-derived tyrannosaurid fact.

classificationSignals: travel tangent changes over the interval
turn.crossover: forbidden unless the turn explicitly declares a pivot or high-speed crossover
turn.roleRequirement: Report inner and outer contacts separately; a single scalar width is insufficient.

candidateAgainstV8_2.note: Absolute inherited penetration is a separate gate; V8.3 must not hide it behind candidate-vs-baseline regression.

absoluteContact.requiredDisposition: correct baseline/render plane or record an explicit approved legacy exception

primarySources.role: Tyrannosaurid trackways: narrow trackway and slight inward pes rotation are trackway-specific evidence.
Early-theropod trackways: narrow digitigrade gait is common in the discussed record, with wider stance in some low-speed/rest contexts.
Step width in the studied non-avian theropod trackways decreases continuously with increasing stride length/speed.

recommendedEvidence.camera: Locked orthographic top-down camera with an effectively infinite ground surface or plane boundary outside the crop.
recommendedEvidence.comparison: Synchronized V8.2-left/V8.3-right panes plus side/front/three-quarter and a foot macro crop.
doNotUseAsSoleProof: a finite plane edge inside the frame
